elements.requirement: Where the amount of any debt to which this Part applies is referable to a period of time, the total amount payable to an employee in respect of that debt must not exceed £450 in respect of any one week.
elements.quote: The total amount payable to an employee in respect of any debt to which this Part applies, where the amount of the debt is referable to a period of time, shall not exceed— (a) £450 in respect of any one week

elements.requirement: Where the amount of any debt to which this Part applies is referable to a period shorter than a week, the total amount payable to an employee must not exceed an amount bearing the same proportion to £450 as that shorter period bears to a week.
elements.quote: in respect of a shorter period, an amount bearing the same proportion to £450 as that shorter period bears to a week

thresholds.quote: £450 in respect of any one week

thresholds.what: period of time for which the £450 maximum amount applies
